title: Verify: HeaderOverlay unit tests
summary: Unit tests for HeaderOverlay states and store toggles
description: Add tests/headerOverlay.test.tsx proving the header renders each state and toggles the real store.
acceptance_criteria: Ready, loading and error states asserted
Sound and Settings clicks flip store flags
technical_constraints: Use roundFixture from tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirrors the backend world.Round JSON (id, number, status, starts_at, ends_at)

steps.action: Create jsdom test file with jest-dom import; beforeEach reset useUiStore.setState({soundEnabled:true,settingsOpen:false}). Test 'ready': render HeaderOverlay worldTitle "The Boy's Room" round roundFixture; assert getByText('StoryForge'), getByText("The Boy's Room"), getByText('round-1'), getByText('OPEN'), getByRole('timer'). Test 'loading': loading true; assert getByText('Loading round…') and queryByRole('timer') null. Test 'error': error 'Could not load round (HTTP 500)'; assert getByRole('alert') has that text and queryByText('Round unavailable') null.
Click getByRole('button',{name:'Sound'}); assert useUiStore.getState().soundEnabled false and aria-pressed 'false'. Click getByRole('button',{name:'Settings'}); assert settingsOpen true.
